title: Agent tool observation (internal reference format)
description: Reference contract for what a tool returns to an agent. Existing tool protocols are NOT required to change; adapters map into this shape for validation. Values are untrusted data for the consuming agent.

status.description: Tri-state result. Anything else is an invalid transition and must be rejected.

summary.description: One-line outcome. Never re-emit verbatim tool payload already visible to the model.

artifacts.description: Paths or IDs of produced files. Prefer references over inlined content.

next_actions.description: Actionable follow-ups. Required in spirit for every error path.

error.description: null on success; on error, a classified contract object.

backoff.description: Shared-resource pressure (rate limits) should use exponential-jitter.

stop_condition.description: Explicit abort criterion; no stop condition = finding.

metadata.description: Correlation ids, durations. No secrets, no raw external content dumps.
